event.title: Stay safe from scams
event.intro: Learn the tricks scammers use, then take the quiz.

ui.exitConfirm: Leave the quiz? Your answers so far will be lost.
ui.soldOut: All souvenirs have been given out. Thank you for taking part!
ui.afterFull: Great job! You know how to spot scams.
ui.afterPartial: Review the answers, then try again.
ui.allCorrectMsg: Show this QR code to an MOM officer for your souvenir.
ui.earnedBefore: You got all correct before, so your QR code is still valid.
ui.partialMsg: Review the answers, then try again for a souvenir.

learn[0].title: Fake MOM officer
learn[0].tagline: Scammers pretend to be MOM or the Police.
learn[0].chat.lines[0]: Hello, I am from MOM. There is a problem with your work permit.
learn[0].chat.lines[1]: Transfer $500 now, or you will be sent home!
learn[0].chat.lines[2]: Install this app from my link so I can help you.
learn[0].chat.lines[3]: Now I will transfer your call to the Police.
learn[0].flags[0].label: Asks you to transfer money
learn[0].flags[1].label: App from a link, not the app store
learn[0].flags[2].label: Transfers your call to the Police
learn[0].todo[0]: MOM may call you about your work. But MOM will never ask you to transfer money or give your bank login.
learn[0].todo[1]: MOM will never ask you to install an app from a link, or transfer your call to the Police. Unsure? Hang up.
learn[1].title: Fake festive deal
learn[1].tagline: Too-good deals that make you install an app.
learn[1].flags[0].label: Price is too good to be true
learn[1].flags[1].label: App from a link, not the app store
learn[1].flags[2].label: Rushes you
learn[1].todo[0]: Only install apps from the official app store (Google Play or Apple App Store).
learn[1].todo[1]: Fake apps can steal money from your bank account.
learn[2].title: Easy money (scam mule)
learn[2].tagline: Paying you to use your bank account.
learn[2].chat.lines[0]: Want easy money? $300 a week, no work!
learn[2].chat.lines[1]: Just let me use your bank account, SIM card or Singpass.
learn[2].flags[0].label: Money for no work
learn[2].flags[1].label: Wants your bank account, SIM card or Singpass
learn[2].todo[0]: Never sell, lend or give away your bank account, SIM card or Singpass.
learn[2].todo[1]: This is a crime. You can be fined, jailed or caned.
learn[3].title: Fake job or work permit
learn[3].tagline: Fake approval letters that ask for money.
learn[3].chat.lines[0]: Good news! Your work permit is approved.
learn[3].chat.lines[1]: Send $800 today to confirm your job.
learn[3].chat.lines[2]: We are a licensed agency. Licence no. 99X9999.
learn[3].flags[0].label: Asks you to pay first
learn[3].flags[1].label: A licence number does not prove it is real
learn[3].todo[0]: Check your work pass yourself on MOM's website: "Check work pass and application status". No login needed.
learn[3].todo[1]: Asking you to pay first is a common job scam sign. Scammers can fake letters and copy licence numbers.
learn[4].title: Secret codes (OTP)
learn[4].tagline: Scammers ask for the code sent to your phone.
learn[4].chat.lines[0]: Sorry, I sent a code to your phone by mistake.
learn[4].chat.lines[1]: Please send me the 6-digit code. Quick!
learn[4].flags[0].label: Asks for your OTP and rushes you
learn[4].todo[0]: Never share your OTP (the code sent to your phone) with anyone.
learn[4].todo[1]: Remember ACT: ADD the ScamShield app, CHECK with 1799, TELL family and friends.
quiz[0].title: Spot the red flags
quiz[0].msg.bubbles[0][1].t: you have an unpaid work permit fine of $350.
quiz[0].msg.bubbles[1][2].t: or reply with your bank login.
quiz[0].explain: Government SMSes come from "gov.sg". Real MOM addresses end with ".mom.gov.sg". The Government never asks for your bank login by SMS. Unsure? Call 1799.
quiz[1].title: Scam or safe?
quiz[1].cards[0].text: Please buy rice on the way home. Thank you!
quiz[1].cards[0].why: A normal message from someone you know, with no money or codes asked.
quiz[1].cards[1].text: Your bank account is locked. Reply with the OTP we just sent you.
quiz[1].cards[1].why: Never share your OTP (the code sent to your phone) with anyone, even if they say they are your bank.
quiz[1].cards[2].text: Lend me your bank card for one week. I will pay you $300.
quiz[1].cards[2].why: This is a scam mule offer. Letting others use your bank card is a crime.
quiz[1].cards[3].text: Happy Deepavali! See you at the event on Sunday.
quiz[1].cards[3].why: A normal greeting from a friend, with nothing asked.
quiz[2].title: What would you reply?
quiz[2].chat.lines[0]: Hi, it's your cousin. I changed my number.
quiz[2].chat.lines[1]: I sent a 6-digit code to your phone by mistake. Can you send it to me? Urgent!
quiz[2].options[1]: No. I never share codes. I will call your old number.
quiz[2].options[2]: Send me your photo first, then I will send it.
quiz[2].explain: Never share your OTP, even with family. If someone says they changed their number, call their old number to check.
quiz[3].title: Pick the safe way
quiz[3].prompt: You want a shopping app for Deepavali deals. Where should you get it?
quiz[3].options[0].label: The official app store on your phone
quiz[3].options[1].label: A link sent in a chat message
quiz[3].options[2].label: A link in an online advert
quiz[3].explain: Only install apps from the official app store (Google Play or Apple App Store). Apps from links can steal your money.
quiz[4].title: Spot the red flags
quiz[4].msg.bubbles[0][0].t: Your employer wants to cancel your work permit.
quiz[4].msg.bubbles[1][0].t: Pay me $500 to keep your job.
quiz[4].msg.bubbles[2][2].t: and send me your Singpass password.
quiz[4].explain: It is illegal to make you pay to keep your job. Real MOM addresses end with ".mom.gov.sg". Never share your Singpass password.
quiz[5].title: What would you reply?
quiz[5].chat.lines[1]: Just let me use your bank account and Singpass.
quiz[5].options[2]: No. This is a crime. I will report it.
quiz[5].explain: Letting others use your bank account or Singpass makes you a scam mule. It is a crime. Say no and report it.

feedback.learnedOptions[0].label: Yes
